subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Students performed a reenactment of an old trial.”?
options: Then they studied the real documents and saw how serious the case had been.
A media class studied the case.
In history class, students studied a map showing borders from one hundred years ago.
After teachers saw it, the school fixed several problem areas and changed event routes.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Then they studied the real documents and saw how serious the case had been.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「A media class studied the case.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「In history class, students studied a map showing borders from one hundred years ago.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「After teachers saw it, the school fixed several problem areas and changed event routes.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Then they studied the real documents and saw how serious the case had been.」，答案為「Then they studied the real documents and saw how serious the case had been.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Then they studied the real documents and saw how serious the case had been.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
